title: A trial of an incremental summary view is approved
turns: The weekly totals on Fernwatch take about 300 ms now and the readings table keeps growing. Postgres has an extension called pg_ivm that keeps a summary view up to date incrementally instead of recalculating it.
Yes, go ahead and try it. Staging database only, the weekly totals view, two weeks, and I'll judge it by how stale the numbers get.
